title: Runtime Player Control Channel intent.speechStream payload (voice swap Wave 1)
description: Payload for the intent.speechStream kind (ADDED ADDITIVELY over intent.set/intent.envelope/intent.speech). The STREAMED form of the intent.speech mora列: one utterance is open -> append x N -> end, all naming the same utteranceId. open starts the utterance and replaces the previous one; t=0 is the 器's acceptance instant of the open. append carries the next 1..512 moras; timeMs is relative to the utterance's t=0 and strictly increasing WITHIN the utterance (across appends), and one utterance holds at most maxUtteranceTimelineLength (4096) moras. The mora item is exactly intent.speech's. end says no more moras follow: until end the 器 holds the last vowel when the data runs out (no automatic close); after end the usual terminal (hold the last interval, then release over 400ms) applies. An append/end naming an utteranceId that is not the current open utterance (a stale tail of a replaced or stopped utterance) is accepted and ignored. A forced mouth release (a per-slot intent on a mouth slot, e.g. intent.set mouth-open=0, or a disconnect) stops the open utterance too; its later append/end are then ignored. A malformed shape, a non-monotonic continuation or an over-cap utterance is rejected with invalidPayload; an out-of-domain s with slotValueOutOfRange; an unwritable mouth group (open/append) with slotNotWritable (no new code).

utteranceId.description: Soul-chosen id naming one utterance. append/end for an id that is not the current open utterance are accepted and ignored.

timeline.description: The next slice of the utterance's mora列 (1..512 moras per append, the same per-request bound as intent.speech). Its first timeMs must be greater than the previous append's last timeMs, and the utterance's total must stay within maxUtteranceTimelineLength; otherwise invalidPayload.

timeMs.description: Relative time (ms from timeline start). Must be non-negative and strictly greater than the previous mora's timeMs (monotonically increasing); otherwise the timeline is rejected with invalidPayload.

vowel.description: The vowel LABEL for this mora (not a slot id). An unknown label is rejected with invalidPayload.

s.description: Opening strength (PRE-scale) in the mouth-vowel normalized domain 0..1. Out of range is rejected with slotValueOutOfRange (never clamped). A non-finite s is rejected with invalidPayload.
